claims.claim: Materialization sets subject-local LF checkout defaults before checkout and excludes ambient Git configuration and attributes. A focused regression confirmed that an LF-only committed sentinel remains LF-only at the exact subject HEAD with clean tracked state under simulated CRLF policy.
Subject-local checkout settings leave the control repository config unchanged, while tracked .gitattributes still produce explicit CRLF and LF checkout bytes in the subject.

The existing independent clone, exact-HEAD and clean-state checks, empty subject-local .git/aios creation, and cleanup path remain in place. Verification command, cwd, evidence, and Windows TEMP handling were not changed.
The commit changes only src/aios_renew/verification.py and tests/test_verification.py; the working tree is clean.
